name: Abyssal Solidarity
source:
You find yourself in a dark cave and you don't know how you got here.
Something else lurks in this cave, and it seems too familiar with you.

[From [url=https://idolapollo.itch.io/abyssal-solidarity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处一个黑暗的洞穴中，而且你不知道自己是如何来到这里的。
这个山洞里潜伏着别的东西，而且它似乎对你来说太熟悉了。

[来自[url=https://idolapollo.itch.io/abyssal-solidarity]itch.io[/url]]
